personal.valueProposition: I'm a senior full stack engineer who ships production code that scales. After 14+ years building everything from React frontends to distributed microservices, I've deliberately moved into AI/ML implementation because that's where the highest-leverage problems are. welcomeMessage: Hi there! Welcome to my portfolio - I'm Zach, a Staff Software Engineer & AI/ML Architect with 14+ years of experience building enterprise-scale systems and implementing production AI solutions. Rather than making you dig through static content, I've created something much better: meet Arlo, my AI Assistant who knows absolutely everything about my experience, skills, and projects. Arlo can answer your questions instantly, generate custom resumes tailored to your specific needs, and even conduct mock interviews! Let's save time and get straight to what matters - just start chatting with Arlo below. Ask anything!

principles: Start with the business problem, not the technology
approach: Understand constraints first: Budget, timeline, team skills, existing systems
Design for the next 18 months: Not 10 years – requirements will change
Document trade-offs explicitly: Every decision has pros and cons
Build in observability from day one: You can't optimize what you can't measure
Plan for failure: Systems fail; good architectures handle it gracefully
